extendedData.value:
This is the reprinted Base Set unlimited booster pack that introduced the new shadowed border design and card format introduced in Jungle.
Disclaimer: This product comes in 3 different sealed wrapping designs. The design you receive when ordering this product depends on the seller's inventory.

(Not to be confused with the original 1st Edition and Unlimited Shadowless print runs)
